children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) is biased to break a resistance at 4,903 ringgit per metric ton, and bounce more toward 4,930 ringgit.
The contract has broken a falling trendline. The break suggests the completion of a wave C from 5,018 ringgit, which could be broken down into five smaller waves.
The peak of the small wave d around 4,930 ringgit serves as one of the possible targets, which will be confirmed when the market breaks 4,903 ringgit.
The consolidation below 4,903 ringgit is tentatively classified as a pullback toward a falling trendline, unless the contract drops again and breaks the support at 4,843 ringgit.
The break will signal a continuation of the downtrend. On the daily chart, the consolidation from the August 21 high of 5,031 ringgit has taken the shape of either a flat pattern or a double-top.
A double-top would be confirmed when the market breaks 4,814 ringgit while a flat could only be confirmed then the contract breaks 5,032 ringgit.
Regardless of the final pattern, a further bounce might be likely.
